title: Plo Koon
subtitle: Koh-to-yah!
text:
Ambush (When you play this unit, it may ready and attack an enemy unit.)
Coordinate — Raid 3 (Gain this keyword while you control 3 or more units. This unit gets +3/+0 while attacking.)
rules: Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. If there is no enemy unit that can be attacked, the unit does not ready.
